CustomField.description: <engagement link id>::<visitor key>. The external id the draft is upserted on, and the only way to reach it: the visitor key is a random value the browser generates and keeps, so a draft is readable only by the browser that wrote it. Not unique: a Guest User licence permits insert and read on a custom object and nothing else, so a save is an append and the newest row for a key is the draft. Indexed as an external id so that read stays cheap.
CustomField.label: Draft Key
